description.value: Cinnzeo is a Canadian bakery cafe franchise that has been baking fresh cinnamon rolls since 1997, topped with house-made cream cheese frosting. Beyond its signature rolls the menu spans hot and iced espresso drinks, Lavazza coffee, custom lemonades, smoothies, salads, and in-house deli items. This Vancouver location sits inside a multi-tenant commercial building on Kingsway, making it a potential mid-ride sweet stop for cyclists passing through the area.
